messages:
incident-bot: Paging @sre-oncall — Elevated 5xx spike observed in ap-central-asia region (gateway pool apc1). Alert: gateway-5xx-rate > 8% for 120s. Sev: P1. Link: https://ops.redwood.io/incidents/1778889999 :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: on it. joining now. any customer-facing impact yet?

nora: seeing a bunch of 502/504 from edge-proxy to ml-worker pool in apc1. rate ~12% window 2m. latency also up (p95 ~ 2.3s).

jamie: logs show lots of `short write` and downstream connection resets to ml-worker-ephem-*. suspect sticky-session routing mismatch after a partial deploy earlier.

ashok: I can confirm; deploy to apc1-rt on last push at 1778889600 changed the routing table for session affinity. Some older workers didn't pick up the new KV prefix.

eng-runtime: quick check: `curl -s https://apc1-gateway/redwood/v1/health` returns 200 on frontends but `GET /v1/route` returning 502 when proxied to worker groups A2 and B1. attaching small snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T09:13:12Z] gateway apc1 -> worker A2: 502 short write (conn 0x7f9)
[2026-03-15T09:13:13Z] gateway apc1 -> worker B1: timeout waiting for kvcache lock
```

sre-oncall: ok actions: 1) enable regional failover to ap-south1 for apc1 traffic 2) scale up warm spare workers in apc1 group 3) disable session-affinity routing policy (temp) 4) page eng-runtime. doing 1 now.

jamie: +1 to disable affinity. patching route-table to `round_robin` for gateway pool apc1: `reroute --pool apc1 --mode round_robin --reason "mitigate affinity mismatch"`

eng-runtime: received. I can flip the KV prefix sync and push a small hotfix to worker bootstrap to re-register prefixes. ETA 7m for rollout. recommend failover until hotfix done.

support-lead: heads-up: we have ~45 customers with active sessions through apc1 based on session store queries. initial sampling shows ~8 customers seeing degraded responses (timeouts/partial responses). preparing comms if SLA thresholds hit.

nora: traffic is now being redirected to ap-south1 (partial). error rate on apc1 dropped to 6% in the last 30s; global gateway errors reduced overall. some in-flight requests still failing (clients with long-lived websockets).

sre-oncall: scaling warm spare pool in apc1: `gcloud ai instances resize --pool apc1-warm --count 6` — done, pods coming up.

jamie: I'm pushing the prefix-sync hotfix to apc1 canary now. rolling to 10% of workers first. command: `deploy --service runtime-worker --region apc1 --image registry/redwood/rt:prefix-fix-20260315 --canary 10`

eng-runtime: canary looks clean, KV prefixes re-registered, `route` probe passes for canary workers. promoting to 50% now.

support-lead: monitoring customer impact — errors for affected customers down from ~15%->4% after failover and initial hotfix. still tracking websocket clients separately.

nora: websocket proxy still has some resets, investigating keepalive and upstream idle timeouts. quick mitigation: extend idle timeout and allow longer grace on draining nodes.

sre-oncall: disabling session affinity completed. reroute complete. apc1 error rate down to 1.2% over 2m. overall system p95 latency back to normal.

eng-runtime: final rollout done to 100% apc1 workers. KV prefix registration fixed. I left a small migration guard in the bootstrap to avoid future drift.

jamie: added temporary circuit-breaker to drop new sticky routes for 10m: `cb set apc1 sticky_route 10m`

support-lead: raising a post-incident blameless note: customers impacted list + timeline will be sent to #customer-comms in 30m. drafting initial status note now.

sre-oncall: closing paging in 10m if stable; create follow-up runbook task to add automated prefix reconciliation and add a canary gate for route-table changes.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 (after stabilization). Please add postmortem (owner: nora) and link to this thread.

nora: will own postmortem. initial notes: root cause = deploy that changed session-affinity routing without KV prefix migration; mitigations: regional failover, affinity disable, hotfix for prefix registration, scale warm spares. next steps: automation + runbook updates + customer comms.

sre-oncall: marking the channel for handoff to shift lead in 15m. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

jamie: FYI added logs + probe traces to the incident ticket: https://ops.redwood.io/incident/1778889999/logs

support-lead: final: customer-facing impact contained. no major SLA breaches found at 1h check but follow-up comms scheduled.

nora: end of thread — will post postmortem draft in 4h.
